anti_patterns: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for Headings.
Do not use text-7xl or above.

colors.strategy: Functional Color Only. UI should be mostly monochrome with color strictly used for data visualization and direct actions.

grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Cardless, sharp 1px borders.

surface.style: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Focus on exposing the grid skeleton. 1px solid borders, no shadows.
surface.radius: rounded-none md:rounded-sm (Max 4px radius, prefer sharp edges)

motion.hover: Subtle background color shift, -translate-y-[1px] on interactive elements
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out

textures.grain: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the background to kill digital flatness.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn/UI for logic (Forms, Select, Dialog), but strip the Vercel-look. Apply sharp borders, flat backgrounds, and high contrast.
components.charts: Recharts via Shadcn. Use bar charts for skill frequency. Maximize data-ink (remove unnecessary grid lines).
components.tables: Right-align numbers, left-align text. No zebra striping, use padding.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large text. Ensure primary button text is white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='search-submit-button').

image_urls.description: Professional working at laptop. Use for Empty States, Hero section (if any), or onboarding login screens.
Abstract blue data network map. Use for Loading State ('analyzing 50 postings...') background or header accent.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If rendering a company logo in the 'Top Hiring Companies' section, use a robust fallback to initials or a generic building icon if a real image is not available.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via index.html or CSS import.
Implement a cardless, high-density dashboard for the results. Use 1px borders (border-border) and flat backgrounds to separate content instead of heavy shadows or floating cards.
The primary dashboard should display a large, undeniable proof metric (e.g., '42/50 Postings'). Use JetBrains Mono for this number.
For the 'Skills' progress bars, use the brand's primary Klein Blue. Make them sharp (rounded-none).
Implement an AI Insight badge beside relevant skills using a distinct outline style (border-primary text-primary) to signify AI suggestion vs real-frequency skills.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, dropdowns, buttons, and skill cards.
Use Recharts (Shadcn Chart component) to visualize Salary Range and Top Hiring Companies.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp corners for this technical theme) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Never use placeholder text for images or logos. Always use provided images or realistic text fallbacks.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located at /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
